description: Use when rolling Claude Code out to a team or organization, or auditing a rollout already under way — writing or reviewing shared and managed settings.json permissions, deciding which MCP servers, plugins and marketplaces to approve, cleaning up layered AGENTS.md files, or measuring whether the team actually uses it.
